comparison.objective: Transfer a casualty manikin to a stretcher while keeping its head aligned with its body; candidate finishes four threaded inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Whole-body coordinated lifting and articulated-head stabilization versus fine coaxial tooling, hammering, and fragment retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Manikin supported on stretcher without head/body misalignment versus four safe tang fractures and complete containment.
comparison.reason: The scale, mechanism, and protected state are materially different. No spec versions or allowable head-alignment limits are available.
